Source: [pkg/reasoning/mcpserver/doc.go](https://github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/blob/main/pkg/reasoning/mcpserver/doc.go).

Package mcpserver exposes a reasoning [reasoning.ContextProvider](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning#ContextProvider) as read-only MCP tools for model-driven investigation.

Each tool maps to one context template and accepts only resource IDs the provider knows. Every call is answered from the provider's immutable graph copy and pinned telemetry for one analysis token; tools cannot read live state, write anything, or reach a different graph digest. Results are bounded and report whether any collection was truncated.

Tools:

  - get\_security\_neighborhood: one-hop relationships around the anchors.
  - get\_telemetry\_chain: pinned telemetry touching the anchors.
  - get\_governance\_posture: governed-by relationships and facets, without inferring policy effect.
  - find\_graph\_paths: the subgraph within a fixed hop limit of the anchors, over every registered predicate except runs-on or an explicit predicate allowlist. It returns reachable resources and relationships, not individual paths; the name predates that and is kept for compatibility.
  - get\_incident\_timeline: ordered incident observations for the anchors.
  - get\_behavior\_baseline: previously observed behavior for the anchors.

The reasoning runtime uses [ConnectInMemory](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning/mcpserver#ConnectInMemory), so no MCP transport is exposed outside the process. The standalone command exposes [NewHTTPHandler](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning/mcpserver#NewHTTPHandler) over streamable HTTP. [ServeStdio](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/reasoning/mcpserver#ServeStdio) remains available to embedders for local experiments.
